title: 70 kg se 60 kg: Wo 10 Kilo Fat Gaya Kahan?
title_options: 70 kg se 60 kg: Wo 10 Kilo Fat Gaya Kahan?
Fat Loss Ka Sach Jo Doctors Bhi Nahi Jaante
Jab Weight Kam Hota Hai, Fat Jaata Kahan Hai?
summary: A science explainer on the well-known misconception about where body fat physically goes during weight loss, using the 2014 BMJ study by Meerman and Brown. It walks through the triglyceride oxidation chemistry to show that losing 10 kg of fat (going from 70 kg to 60 kg) means about 8.4 kg is exhaled as carbon dioxide and 1.6 kg leaves as water.

facts.fact: Ruben Meerman and Andrew Brown published 'When somebody loses weight, where does the fat go?' in BMJ 2014;349:g7257.
In the study's survey, more than 50% of 150 doctors, dietitians and personal trainers thought fat converts to energy or heat when lost.
According to a review of the survey, none of the doctors or personal trainers answered correctly, and only 6 of 50 dietitians gave the right answer.
The correct answer: fat is converted to carbon dioxide, which is exhaled, and water, which leaves as urine, sweat and other fluids.
Human body fat is stored as triglyceride, with an average molecular formula of C55H104O6 and molecular weight of 861 daltons.
Complete oxidation reaction: C55H104O6 + 78 O2 → 55 CO2 + 52 H2O + energy.
Calculation shows (661 Da carbon + 64 Da oxygen) / 861 Da total × 100 = 84% of a triglyceride's mass is exhaled as CO2; the remaining 16% becomes water.
When somebody loses 10 kg of fat (triglyceride), 8.4 kg is exhaled as CO2, leaving 1.6 kg to exit as water.
At rest, an average 70 kg person exhales about 200 ml of CO2 over 12 breaths per minute, excreting roughly 203 g of carbon over a full day of rest and light activity.
Standing up and getting dressed more than doubles metabolic rate; trying on outfits for 24 hours would exhale over 1,200 g of CO2.
The oxygen atoms of a triglyceride are shared between CO2 and water in a 2:1 ratio, a fact established by Lifson and colleagues in 1949 using heavy oxygen (O18) tracing.
facts.source: BMJ (Meerman & Brown), 2014, citing Lifson et al., 1949

youtube.title: 70 kg se 60 kg: Wo 10 Kilo Fat Gaya Kahan? Science Explained
youtube.description:
Jab weight 70 kg se 60 kg hota hai, wo 10 kilo fat literally gaya kahan? Is video mein hum 2014 ke BMJ study (Ruben Meerman aur Andrew Brown) ke through dekhte hain ki fat kaise carbon dioxide aur water mein convert hota hai - aur kyun zyada tar doctors, dietitians aur personal trainers bhi is sawaal ka sahi jawab nahi de paye.

Topics covered:
- Fat loss ke baare mein sabse common myth
- Conservation of mass ka concept
- Triglyceride (C55H104O6) ki chemistry
- 84% CO2 aur 16% water ka exact calculation
- 70 kg se 60 kg ke case mein real numbers

Sources:
- Meerman R, Brown AJ. 'When somebody loses weight, where does the fat go?' BMJ 2014;349:g7257 - https://www.bmj.com/content/349/bmj.g7257
- UNSW Newsroom, 'When we lose weight, where does the fat go?' (2014) - https://www.unsw.edu.au/newsroom/news/2014/12/when-we-lose-weight--where-does-the-fat-go--
- SciTechDaily reprint by Meerman & Brown - https://scitechdaily.com/when-you-lose-weight-where-does-it-actually-go/

scenes.narration: [curious] Maan lijiye kisi ka weight seventy kilogram se ghatkar sixty kilogram ho jaata hai… wo das kilo fat gaya kahan?

visual.text: Where did the 10 kg of fat go?

scenes.beat: Hook question - where does 10 kg of fat go when weight drops 70 to 60 kg?

scenes.narration: [explaining] Zyada tar log sochte hain ki fat energy banta hai, ya muscle mein badalta hai, ya sweat aur toilet se nikal jaata hai.
scenes.beat: List common guesses - converted to energy, muscle, sweat, toilet.

scenes.narration: [measured] BMJ journal ki do thousand fourteen ki study mein yahi sawaal one hundred fifty doctors, dietitians aur personal trainers se poocha gaya tha.
scenes.beat: BMJ 2014 study surveyed 150 doctors, dietitians, personal trainers with this exact question.

scenes.narration: [measured] Un mein se fifty percent se zyada logon ne socha ki fat lose hone par energy ya heat mein badal jaata hai.
scenes.beat: Over half of them guessed fat turns into energy or heat.

scenes.narration: [serious] Hairaani ki baat yeh hai ki ek bhi doctor ya trainer sahi jawaab nahi de paaya, sirf fifty dietitians mein se six sahi nikle.
scenes.beat: Not one doctor or trainer got it right; only six dietitians did.

scenes.narration: [curious] Agar fat sach mein energy ban gaya, toh uska mass, matlab wo physical weight, gaya kahan?

visual.text: If fat became energy, where did the mass go?

scenes.beat: Re-hook - if fat became energy, where did the mass physically go?

scenes.narration: [explaining] Physics ka ek basic niyam hai, conservation of mass, jiske according matter kabhi yun hi gayab nahi ho sakta.

lines.text: Mass cannot be created or destroyed

scenes.beat: Law of conservation of mass - matter cannot simply vanish.

scenes.narration: [thoughtful] Iska matlab yeh hai ki fat banane wale atoms ko body se kisi na kisi route se bahar nikalna hi padega.
scenes.beat: Fat atoms must physically exit the body through some route.

scenes.narration: [calm] सही जवाब यह है कि fat body से carbon dioxide के रूप में exhale होता है, और बचा हुआ हिस्सा पानी बनकर निकलता है।

visual.title: Fat Becomes CO2 and Water
visual.subtitle: Not energy, not muscle, not sweat alone

scenes.beat: Correct answer - fat leaves the body as exhaled carbon dioxide and water.

scenes.narration: [curious] लेकिन असली सवाल यह है कि इसमें से कितना हिस्सा gas बनकर निकलता है, और कितना पानी बनकर?

visual.text: How much leaves as CO2 vs water?

scenes.beat: Re-hook - how much exits as gas versus how much as water?

scenes.narration: [explaining] इसे समझने के लिए पहले जानिए कि body fat असल में triglyceride नाम के molecule के रूप में store होता है।

visual.title: Triglyceride Molecule
visual.subtitle: Three fatty acids + one glycerol backbone

scenes.beat: Body fat is stored as triglyceride molecules - three fatty acids plus glycerol.

scenes.narration: [measured] एक average human triglyceride का formula होता है C fifty-five, H one hundred four, O six, जिसका molecular weight eight hundred sixty-one daltons है।
scenes.beat: Average human triglyceride formula is C55H104O6, molecular weight 861 daltons.

scenes.narration: [measured] हमारी calculation के लिए known value यह है कि एक triglyceride molecule का total weight eight hundred sixty-one daltons होता है।
scenes.beat: Known value - one triglyceride molecule weighs 861 daltons in total.

scenes.narration: [curious] अब required quantity यह है कि इस कुल mass में से कितना percent carbon dioxide बनेगा, और कितना percent पानी?

visual.text: What percent becomes CO2, and what percent becomes water?

scenes.beat: Required quantity - what percentage of that mass leaves as CO2 versus water.

scenes.narration: [explaining] Oxidation की equation कहती है कि triglyceride plus seventy-eight oxygen molecules मिलकर fifty-five carbon dioxide, fifty-two water, और energy बनाते हैं।
scenes.beat: Oxidation equation - C55H104O6 plus 78 O2 gives 55 CO2, 52 H2O, energy.

scenes.narration: [explaining] इसमें triglyceride के सभी fifty-five carbon atoms, और छह में से चार oxygen atoms, carbon dioxide बनाकर बाहर निकलते हैं।
scenes.beat: Variables - all 55 carbons plus 4 of the 6 oxygens leave as CO2.

scenes.narration: [measured] Carbon ka mass hai six hundred sixty-one daltons, oxygen ka mass hai sixty-four daltons… total hua seven hundred twenty-five daltons.
scenes.beat: Substitution - carbon mass 661 Da plus oxygen mass 64 Da equals 725 Da.

scenes.narration: [measured] Ab is seven hundred twenty-five ko total weight eight hundred sixty-one se divide kijiye, phir sau se multiply kijiye.
scenes.beat: Intermediate step - divide 725 by 861, then multiply by 100.

scenes.narration: [emphatic] Answer yeh hai ki triglyceride ka eighty-four percent mass carbon dioxide banta hai, aur sixteen percent paani banta hai.

visual.label: Mass exits as CO2 (16% as water)

scenes.beat: Answer - 84 percent of fat mass exits as CO2, 16 percent as water.

scenes.narration: [curious] Ab isi eighty-four aur sixteen percent ratio ko apply karte hain us case par, jahan weight seventy kilogram se sixty kilogram hui.
scenes.beat: Re-hook - now apply this ratio to the 70 kg to 60 kg case.

scenes.narration: [measured] Is case mein exactly ten kilogram body fat loss hua hai… yahi humara known value hai.
scenes.beat: Known values - exactly 10 kg of body fat was lost in this case.

scenes.narration: [explaining] Ab required quantity nikalni hai - in ten kilogram fat mein se kitna carbon dioxide banega aur kitna paani banega.
scenes.beat: Required quantity - find the exact CO2 mass and water mass produced.

scenes.narration: [measured] Substitution kijiye - ten kilogram ka eighty-four percent nikalne par milta hai eight point four kilogram carbon dioxide.
scenes.beat: Substitution - 10 kg times 84 percent equals 8.4 kg of carbon dioxide.

scenes.narration: [measured] Aur bache hue sixteen percent se banta hai one point six kilogram paani, jo baaki nikal jata hai.
scenes.beat: Substitution - 10 kg times 16 percent equals 1.6 kg of water.

scenes.narration: [emphatic] [measured] यानी आठ दशमलव चार किलो directly आपके lungs के through, saans ke saath bahar nikal jaata hai.
scenes.beat: Interpretation - 8.4 kg is literally breathed out through the lungs.

scenes.narration: [explaining] बacha hua ek दशमलव छह किलो paani, urine, sweat, tears aur saans ki namee ke roop mein body se nikal jaata hai.
scenes.beat: Remaining 1.6 kg of water leaves as urine, sweat, tears and breath moisture.

scenes.narration: [thoughtful] Toh socho, jo organ sabse zyada fat bahar nikaalta hai, woh skin nahi, balki aapke lungs hain.
scenes.beat: Re-hook - so lungs, not skin, are the real fat-loss organ.

scenes.narration: [measured] Rest karte waqt, aapka body har barah breaths mein lagbhag do sau millilitre carbon dioxide exhale karta hai.

visual.label: CO2 exhaled per 12 breaths at rest

scenes.beat: At rest, the body exhales about 200 ml of CO2 every 12 breaths.

scenes.narration: [explaining] Jaise hi aap movement ya exercise karte hain, CO2 output badh jaata hai, aur fat utni hi tezi se nikalta hai.
scenes.beat: Movement and exercise raise CO2 output, speeding up how fast fat leaves.

scenes.narration: [serious] Lekin sweat karna ya paani peena fat kam nahi karta, woh sirf temporary water weight ka shift hai.
scenes.onScreen: Water weight is not fat loss
scenes.beat: Sweating or drinking water does not remove fat, only shifts water weight.

scenes.narration: [emphatic] Asli fat loss ke liye energy deficit chahiye, jo body ko triglyceride oxidise karne par majboor kare.
scenes.beat: Real fat loss needs an energy deficit that forces triglyceride oxidation.

scenes.narration: [calm] Agli baar jab weight kam ho, yaad rakhiye ki fat literally saans ke saath hawa mein ghul jaata hai.
scenes.beat: Closing line - next time weight drops, remember the fat dissolved into thin air.
